title: Docs, the API list and the REPL

blocks.text: The `#` comments you write right above function and struct definitions are turned into Markdown API documentation by `gg doc`:

code: fn add(a: i32, b: i32) -> i32:
gg doc src/                 # print to the screen
gg doc src/ -o API_DOCS.md  # save to a file

blocks.text: **`gg api`** lists every public name of the standard library with its signature and a one-line description (`gg api --json` gives it in machine-readable form; the reference on this site is built from it). **`gg repl`** opens an interactive prompt: you type declarations, bindings and expressions and see the result at once.

code: gg api                      # the whole standard library

blocks.q: Where does `gg doc` take the documentation from?
blocks.why: The comments stay next to the code, so the docs do not go stale.
